sections.headline: Common Care Questions
sections.subheadline: Transparent answers regarding our methods, processing times, and handling policies.

items.question: How do you handle delicate silks and fragile weaves?
items.answer: We utilize specialized, low-stress cleaning solvents tailored specifically for delicate fibers to prevent snagging, shrinkage, or color bleed.

items.question: Can you guarantee the removal of old, set-in stains?
items.answer: While we cannot guarantee every set-in stain, our technicians have decades of experience executing tiered treatments to lift complex spots safely.

items.question: How long does specialized leather cleaning take?
items.answer: Leather and suede require distinct processing environments and careful conditioning. Please allow 7-10 days for professional restoration.

items.question: Is pickup and delivery available in the Castro area?
items.answer: Yes, we provide neighborhood-specific route pickups. You can coordinate scheduling by phone or dropping by our storefront.
